scenes.text: An equation says two quantities are equal. Use inverse operations to solve for the unknown.
Solve x plus 17 equals 41. The answer is 24. x equals 41 minus 17 equals 24.
A box at a science exhibition has 8 stickers plus x more; altogether there are 18. What is x? Pause the video and think.
A box at a science exhibition has 8 stickers plus x more; altogether there are 18. What is x? The answer is 10. x equals 18 minus 8 equals 10.
